symptom: describe → exec turned a read-only data view editable: `describe page` printed `dataview dataView1 (DataSource: microflow …, ReadOnlyStyle: Text)` without Editable, and `Editable: Never` written by hand was ignored (exec: "Unchanged page", stored Forms$DataView.Editability stayed Always); `alter page … set (Editable: Never) on dataView1` was refused as "a DataView has no Editable property"
cause: A data view stores the enum under `Editability` (Mendix 10.7+), where input widgets store `Editable`. The page builder put the authored value on the BaseWidget like every widget, but the writer took the data view's Editability from DataView.ReadOnly, a field nothing sets; the describe parser's DataView case read neither key; the page mutator only knew the pre-10.7 boolean `Editable`
fix: Write pages.WidgetEditability(&x.BaseWidget) for a data view (so Conditional is written beside its settings element too); describe reads `Editability`; the mutator writes `Editability` when the widget stores it
insight: The builder was right all along, which is why `check` and the builder-level tests were green: the value was dropped one layer down by a writer reading a dead field. Grep the semantic struct's field for writers (`\.ReadOnly =`): none in the tree is the tell. The key name is version-dependent — Model SDK version.go has Forms$DataView `editable` Deleted 10.7.0 and `editability` Introduced 10.7.0, and the mutator's own test faked a DataView with a boolean Editable, so it asserted the pre-10.7 shape only. Survey a Studio Pro fixture before trusting a test's hand-built document: PedApp has 41 of 41 data views with Editability and none with Editable
